name: CPT Post Title Trimmer
author: Samarjit Kashyp

sections.description:
CPT Post Title Trimmer is the perfect solution for WordPress title management. Trim long post titles, optimize title length, and control title display across all Custom Post Types.

Key Features

  • Post Title Trimmer – Automatically trim long post titles
  • Title Length Control – Set exact word or character limits
  • Title Optimizer – Optimize title display without affecting SEO
  • Custom Post Type Support – Works with posts, pages, and all CPTs
  • Word/Character Based Trimming – Choose your preferred method
  • SEO Friendly – Only affects display, not actual SEO titles
  • Admin Area Control – Enable trimming in WordPress admin
  • Mobile Responsive – Perfect for card layouts and mobile designs
  • Professional Support – Connect with developer for help and updates

Popular Search Terms

  • Post Title Trimmer WordPress
  • Title Trimmer Plugin
  • How to Trim Titles in WordPress
  • Title Length Optimizer
  • Custom Post Type Title Management
  • SEO Title Display Control
  • WordPress Title Trimmer

Perfect For

  • Title Trimming for post grids and archives
  • Title Optimization for better user experience
  • Post Title Management across all custom post types
  • Title Length Control for consistent designs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cpt-post-title-trimmer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Title Trimmer to configure the plugin
  4. Select post types and set your title trimming preferences
sections.faq:
Which post types are supported?

All public post types including built-in posts and pages, plus any custom post types. Perfect post title trimmer for any content type.

Can I use different settings for different post types?

Currently, the same settings apply to all selected post types. This title trimmer applies consistent rules across your site.

Will this affect my SEO?

No, this only affects the display of titles, not the actual HTML title tag or SEO metadata. It’s a safe title optimizer for your WordPress site.

Is this a post title trimmer or title optimizer?

Both! It trims long post titles and optimizes title length display while keeping your original titles intact for SEO.

How can I get support or connect with the developer?

Visit the plugin settings page to access documentation, report issues, and connect with the developer on social media platforms.
